scope: 义务教育基础词汇补充 + 人教版（2019）必修1-3 + 选择性必修1-2

normalization.deduplication: headword exact match; single words and phrases are counted separately
normalization.inflection_policy: headword list stores base entries; runtime matching applies the documented lemma resolver and does not count inflected forms as new headwords
normalization.derivation_policy: derivatives are accepted only when present in a source headword list or produced by an approved curriculum word-formation rule; they do not increase the baseline estimate
normalization.phrase_policy: phrases remain exact multiword allowlist entries and are excluded from the single-headword count
normalization.proper_noun_policy: ordinary curriculum proper nouns may remain as lexical entries; generated content still must not use real people, schools, or exam identifiers

sources.license_status: word membership reference only; no meanings or textbook passages redistributed
